scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a short chance to add a recipe-story keepsake to Rosalind’s already planned senior-center luncheon.
Emerging Need: The add-on becomes worthwhile only after same-day attendance and recipe-card readiness are known, and while a cancellation booth slot can still be held.
Decision Context: Calendar, contact, message, and program emails establish the outing, reply route, eligibility, and cutoff; a saved preference identifies the acceptable recording format and consent limits.
Consequence: Timely coordination could create a pleasant no-cost family memento, while inaction simply leaves the luncheon unchanged once the empty slot is reassigned.

parameter.title: Rosalind - Tidewater Recipe Swap Luncheon
parameter.description: Senior center recipe swap and lunch; center shuttle pickup is scheduled for 10:50 from Rosalind's building.

parameter.name: Harborview Senior Center Programs Desk
parameter.notes: Handles same-day activity table holds and recipe-swap booth release replies.

parameter.content: I found the crab soup recipe card for the swap and put it in my tote. Still taking the 10:50 shuttle, then I will keep my phone quiet during the ride.

parameter.subject: Recipe Swap: one story-booth opening
parameter.body: One attendee canceled a no-cost 11:35 recipe-story booth slot during today's luncheon. It can be held for a luncheon guest who has a recipe card. The volunteer can set up either the quiet audio table in Room 2 or the lobby video stand. Reply to this desk by 10:30; after that the empty slot goes to the onsite waitlist.

parameter.subject: Recipe Swap story-booth opening filled
parameter.body: The 11:35 cancellation slot has been released to the onsite waitlist and is no longer available for advance holds. The recipe-swap luncheon schedule is unchanged.
